topic: Someone discovers their neighbor is secretly wealthy
text: Just found out that Tom, our neighbor, has been living a double life. Turns out, the guy who's always dressed in modest clothes and drives a basic sedan is actually rolling in it. I was over at his place yesterday, helping him fix his fence, and there it was—a stack of photos on his coffee table. Images of him at some fancy gala, mingling with celebrities and politicians. His house is filled with these subtle hints of luxury—a piece of art here, a rare vase there. It all seems so out of place. I can't help but wonder what else he's been keeping under wraps. Makes you think, doesn't it?
